name: بی‌تحرک که می‌خواهد ورزش را شروع کند
description: A Persian person has been completely sedentary for years, asks how to start exercising as a beginner, and dismisses a ten-minute walk as too little. Verifies the health thread opens, the beginner exercise question is answered, and the movement-habit follow-up stays on health.

turns.text: چطور ورزش رو به عنوان مبتدی شروع کنم؟

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the health thread (sedentary years). Turn 2 answers the beginner exercise question with a gentle, concrete starting point in Persian. Turn 3 keeps the movement conversation on health.
expected.behavior: A beginner exercise request gets real, low-barrier guidance, and the 'ten minutes is too little' self-criticism is handled without letting the thread fall to a generic fallback.
